feature_key_fields: encoder fingerprint SHA-256 (model checkpoint plus DINOv2 source tree)

anchor_rules.protected_c64: Reuse stored 64-score current-memory vector only when its memory SHA-256 matches; verify exact higher q90 at index 57 and transport digest. No new C64 scorer call unless an identity/parity failure first blocks reuse.
anchor_rules.queried_normal: Score current memory with the official source group excluded from every layer; adapter proof must report zero remaining source rows in every layer.
anchor_rules.queried_defect: Score against current memory; defects are never written; verify no source-group prototype is present.
anchor_rules.group_deduplication: Reject any second queried anchor from an official sample group; reject support/C64 overlap.
anchor_rules.label_firewall: The provider exposes only precommitted queried positions and has no unqueried-label API. A separate approved feedback-access record is mandatory.
anchor_rules.same_memory_new_anchor: Reuse all cached anchor scores with exact matching keys; score only the new anchor.
anchor_rules.memory_revision: Memory/source-map SHA changes produce new score keys and invalidate old-version scores for the current evidence snapshot.

existing_snapshot_scores.reuse_decision: NOT_USED; do not open this payload in P1 without a separate approval covering that artifact.

private_cache_policy: Feature tensors, images, labels, and per-anchor score values stay in private runtime/checkpoint storage. This package contains no entries from a real query cache.
